Name: Season 6: Season of Opportunity
Description:
Carve your destiny through the depths of Aeternum to uncover seasonal armor and weapon skins, transmog tokens, and other treasures long lost to the outside world. Welcome to the cursed isle.

• Mysterious Artifacts of unknown origin continue to tempt even the most ambitious Adventurers. Wear the <font color="#edc63e">Cowl of Power</font> to turn the tide of battle when your mana is low or wield the <font color="#edc63e">Grace Greatsword</font> for greater offensive speed.

• Plunge into your next quest with <font color="#edc63e">Nautical Gladiator armor and weapon skins</font> and serenade your fellow Adventurers with one of the <font color="#edc63e">Seafarers Musical Instruments</font>.

• You can also look forward to acquiring the <font color="#edc63e">Seafarers Camp skin</font>, plus unique emotes like <font color="#edc63e">Finger Guns</font>.


Discover the full collection of rewards, including <font color="#edc63e">7,500 Marks of Fortune</font> and <font color="#edc63e">7 Transmog Tokens</font>, through the in-game Season Pass menu.
